name: shirudo-dev/shirudo
title: OpenAI and Cisco open-source Shirudo, an eBPF runtime where agents write signed temporary shields for running Linux systems
summary: Shirudo lets operators (and agents such as Codex) build signed eBPF or Java micropatches that block a vulnerable code path on a running Linux host without a restart, with TPM-backed attestation. OpenAI reports a Codex-written shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit on live Elasticsearch in a controlled test. Pre-release; production needs Shirudo kernel patches and TPM 2.0. BSD-2-Clause.
